column1: # arca-lake metric registry (RFC-013 §7, normative). One row per metric family.
# Columns: name, type, process, unit, labels, help. labels: comma-separated
# label=value|value|... (closed set) or label=~s3op (an S3 operation name),
# - for none. Every exported family must be listed with the same type and
# labels, and every listed family must be exported (crates/cli tests);
# the HELP lines of /metrics come from the help column.
